today.empty: No habits yet. Start with a tiny one: so easy you can't say no.

today.heroEmpty: Create your first habit to start casting votes.
today.emptyTitle: Your garden starts with a seed

habit.name: Name
habit.timeHint: HH:MM. Leave empty to do it any time of the day.
habit.twoMinuteHint: The minimum version for hard days. It still counts.
habit.intentionHint: "I will [habit] at [time] in [place]". It doubles your odds of doing it.
habit.intentionPlaceholder: I will read at 9 pm in bed
habit.deleteConfirm: Archive this habit? Your history is kept.
habit.reminderWebHint: Reminders are delivered by the phone app (iOS / Android).
habit.anchorHint: Stack it on something you already do: "After [habit], I will do this".
habit.noAnchors: First create the habit you want to stack it on.
habit.contextPlaceholder: When I get home, after dinner…
habit.contextHint: The moment or place that will cue it.
habit.temptationHint: Pair it with something you enjoy: you only get one while doing the other.
habit.temptationPlaceholder: I only listen to my podcast while walking

profile.title: Profile
profile.dayBandsHint: Sets how your day is painted and grouped. Hours after your day ends are hidden from the week.

reminders.body: It is time. A small vote for who you want to be.

garden.votes_one: {{count}} vote for the person you want to become
garden.votes_other: {{count}} votes for the person you want to become
garden.healthGood: Your tree is healthy. Every action counts.
garden.healthLow: Some leaves look tired. One miss is an accident: today you get back on track.
garden.neverMissTwice: You missed last time. That is fine: today is the day you never miss twice.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.heatmapSubtitle: How much you completed each day. Tap a day for details.
progress.bandsTitle: When in the day do you do best?
progress.bandsInsight: The {{band}} is harder for you. Try anchoring those habits to a routine you already have.
progress.onePercentSubtitle: A complete day lifts you 1%; a missed day drops you 1%. Small gains compound.

identity.title: Who do you want to become?
identity.sectionHint: Each identity is a branch of your tree. Your habits are votes for it.
identity.explainer: Habits stick when they are part of who you are. Write the person you want to be, not the goal.
identity.statementPlaceholder: takes care of their body, reads every day, is present…
identity.statementRequired: Write who you want to be
identity.deleteConfirm: Delete this identity? Its habits are kept without an identity.

streak.title: Streak
streak.keepItUp: Complete at least one habit today to keep your streak.
streak.rule: 🛡️ One missed day is forgiven. Two in a row reset the streak. 💤 Days without habits do not count.
streak.milestone66: ~66 days: the median time for a habit to become automatic

account.deleteHint: You can delete your account and all your data at any time.
account.deleteWarning: Your habits, logs, identities and tree will be deleted forever. This cannot be undone.

offline.title: 📡 Offline · your changes are saved here
offline.pending_one: 📡 Offline · {{count}} change will sync when you are back
offline.pending_other: 📡 Offline · {{count}} changes will sync when you are back

yesterday.hint: Did you do it and forget to log it? Tap to check it.

onboarding.skip: I already use the app, skip
onboarding.welcomeBody: I will grow with you. Every habit you complete is a vote for the person you want to become, and this garden makes it visible.
onboarding.identityTitle: Who do you want to become?
onboarding.identityBody: Habits last when they are part of your identity. Do not pick a goal: pick a person.

identitySuggestion.health: I am a person who takes care of their body
identitySuggestion.mind: I am a person who takes care of their mind
identitySuggestion.relationships: I am a person who is present for their people
identitySuggestion.work: I am a person who does work that matters
identitySuggestion.growth: I am a person who learns every day

onboarding.habitTitle: Let us start with one habit
onboarding.habitBody: A small one you can do today. You can add more later.
onboarding.obstacleBody: Your answer turns on a different tool.

forget.label: 🙈 I forget
forget.tip: I will remind you at the habit time. Making it obvious is the first law.

noTime.label: ⏳ I have no time
noTime.tip: We will use the 2-minute rule: the minimum version counts too.

motivation.label: 😮‍💨 I lose motivation
motivation.tip: Your identity stays visible and one miss never erases progress. Just never miss twice.

onboarding.readyBody: Your seed is planted. Complete your habit today and watch your tree grow.
onboarding.permissionHint: We will ask permission to send you the reminder.
